Update on the situation (I'm the mom):
Thank you all for your answers! It was finally resolved quickly. Even though it was super annoying to go to PIBA with a 4-day-old baby, we stood in the visa line (like Israelis getting a passport), and now she’s covered by Bituach Leumi, has a kupat cholim, and we're all set with Tipat Chalav ☺️
